parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Perform the scalar product of the direction vectors and set it equal to zero — M1: $2c+6+4=0$.

Use $P$ to find $\lambda$ — M1: $3-2\lambda=7\Rightarrow\lambda=-2$, with $a+\lambda c=4$ and $b+4\lambda=-2$. Guidance: if the line equation uses $-\lambda$ instead of $+\lambda$, leading to $\lambda=2$, all marks remain available.

Obtain $c=-5$ or $b=6$ — A1.

Obtain $a=-6$, $b=6$, $c=-5$ — A1.

Special case: use $P$ to find $\lambda$ — M1; substitute $\lambda=-2$ into $P$ so $a-2c=4$, and put $\mu=-1$ and $\lambda=-1$ into $l$ so $a-c=-1$, then solve to obtain all three values — A1; maximum 2/4.

Total: 4

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Find $\overrightarrow{PQ}$ (or $\overrightarrow{QP}$) for a general point $Q$ on $m$ — B1: $\overrightarrow{PQ}=\pm(-3+2\mu,-5-3\mu,5+\mu)$. Guidance: may use their $a,b,c,\lambda$ provided both M1 marks were gained in (a); allow the displayed expression.

Equate the scalar product of $\overrightarrow{PQ}$ (or $\overrightarrow{QP}$) and a direction vector for $m$ to zero and obtain an equation in $\mu$ — M1*: $2(-3+2\mu)-3(-5-3\mu)+(5+\mu)=0$. Guidance: allow the sign issue from $\overrightarrow{PQ}=\overrightarrow{OQ}+\overrightarrow{OP}$.

Solve and obtain $\mu=-1$ — A1. Guidance: $PQ^2=(-3+2\mu)^2+(-5-3\mu)^2+(5+\mu)^2=14(\mu+1)^2+45$, whose minimum is at $\mu=-1$, is also valid.

Obtain $\overrightarrow{OQ}=-\mathbf i+5\mathbf j+2\mathbf k$ or $\overrightarrow{PQ}=-5\mathbf i-2\mathbf j+4\mathbf k$, correctly labelled — A1. Guidance: the work may appear in (a) provided at least this result is used in (b).

Carry out a method to find the position vector of $R$ — DM1. Guidance: for example $\overrightarrow{OR}=\overrightarrow{OP}+\frac52\overrightarrow{PQ}$, $\overrightarrow{OR}=\overrightarrow{OQ}+\frac32\overrightarrow{PQ}$, $\overrightarrow{OR}=\frac52\overrightarrow{OQ}-\frac32\overrightarrow{OP}$, or $2(\overrightarrow{OR}-\overrightarrow{OQ})=3\overrightarrow{PQ}$. The vector $\overrightarrow{PQ}$ must be used in the correct direction. Alternative: $\overrightarrow{OR}=(4,7,-2)+t(-5,-2,4)$, $\overrightarrow{QR}=\overrightarrow{OR}-\overrightarrow{OQ}$ and $|QR|=\frac32|PQ|$ gives $t=2.5$.

Obtain $-\frac{17}{2}\mathbf i+2\mathbf j+8\mathbf k$ from correct working — A1. Guidance: accept coordinates; do not accept $-\frac{17}{2}\mathbf i+4\mathbf j+16\mathbf k$.

Special case for equating the lines: attempt to find $\mu=-1$ or $\lambda=-1$ — M1*; obtain $\overrightarrow{OQ}=-\mathbf i+5\mathbf j+2\mathbf k$ — A1; attempt the other parameter — DM1; show the same $Q$ and hence intersection — A1; then use the main scheme for the final DM1 A1. The first DM1 A1 are also available if consistency of all three coordinates is shown.

Total: 6
